# laravelforge_server_php_fpm_config (Resource)

Manages the php-fpm configuration for a given PHP version on a Laravel Forge server. The configuration is a singleton on the server's PHP version (no separate ID): it is read via `GET` and replaced via `PUT`, and removing the resource leaves the configuration in place (Forge has no destroy endpoint for it).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) The php-fpm configuration content.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version key whose php-fpm configuration is managed (e.g. `php82`).
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the PHP version belongs to.
